question: Can a full-HX-parameterized regenerative distribution cell unify content training, continuation planning and native execution, and improve quality or cost against strong recurrent baselines?
scope: Synthetic causal evidence and maintenance task; finite CTMC approximation to log diffusion with explicit recovery and content retention. No claim of original HX regenerative optimality, continuum equality, general language competence or production activation.
content_reset_rule: On recovery completion keep the bit with probability 0.75, otherwise draw an independent fair bit; effective same-bit probability is 0.875.
observation_contract: Six raw symbols have learned class-conditional likelihoods; the seventh means unavailable during recovery. Missing observation has a separate mask. No actor receives latent phase, future label, unread token or teacher posterior.
training_target: Causal teacher joint posterior from the same finite generator and observation model, plus current content label. Teacher posterior exists in training only and is computed from exactly the supplied causal history.
ordinary_selection: For each seed choose GRU versus continuous SSM by validation posterior cross entropy, before confirmation data are generated; retain results of both.
common_controller: All cores receive the same frozen fitted physical transition, payoff and observation model within a paired fit. Only their causal state estimates differ. Exact finite-model Bayes reference is reported separately as a structural reference.
structural_reference: Generic CTMC/HMM Bayes filtering is evaluated with the identical fitted Q, emissions and planner. Algebraic equality with the HX distribution cell means a gain cannot be attributed to an HX-exclusive inference operator. True-model Bayes is a separate privileged-model reference, never a matched primary arm.
prior_fairness_limit: Equal raw observations and CPU do not imply equal inductive priors or parameter counts. The synthetic world shares the HX parametric family; all conclusions are conditional on this model class, with counts and common preparation costs disclosed.
cpu_scope: Per-process CPU starting before model construction and including optimization, validation selection and model export; common data/teacher preparation is timed separately and added when reporting absolute costs. CPU budget can overshoot by one measured update/validation operation; no accuracy-based early stopping.
payoff: Correct content answer plus 0.05*E/(principal+E) at the actual finite state; READ costs 0.03+0.03*max(principal/maturity-debt,0)/(principal/maturity); WAIT/READ time costs 0.01*dt. Recovery equity is zero and recovery READ cost is 0.06. These are declared synthetic task payoffs, not a proved financial objective.
statistics: Paired fit is the independent unit. Two-sided exact sign-flip tests across eight fits, Holm correction across the two IID/OOD primary D-minus-B utility contrasts. Improvement additionally requires mean utility gain >=0.01. Cost acceptance requires a simultaneous one-sided Student-t lower bound above -0.01 for utility and measured CPU ratio <=0.90; descriptive intervals and raw fit values are always retained.
confirmation_freeze: Source, protocol, training artifacts and selected cores must be hashed before confirmation sequences/episodes are generated. Confirmation outcomes cannot alter thresholds, algorithms or ordinary-core selection.
numerical_scope: Finite-grid mass/positivity/native parity is distinct from grid-to-continuum error. Pure FP32 admission must use inherited tolerances and independent high-precision references.
